messages.text: <@U98765ABC> terraform plan on the prod VPC module shows 6 security group rule diffs. Looks like someone edited them in the console during on-call last night.
Yes, that drift is real. I will **import** the rules with `terraform import` and add a nightly drift check job in CI. Tracking it in TRI-15.
Please also remove console write access to prod security groups. Use the break-glass role only, and log every use.
Agreed. TRI-15 blocks Triton GA, so I am treating it as high priority this sprint.
auth-service ArgoCD sync keeps failing on the prod cluster. The cert-manager CRDs get applied after the auth-service manifests.
Put the CRDs in sync-wave -1 with the argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave annotation, then retry. That is the usual fix for CRD ordering.
Sync waves fixed staging. Prod still flaky, keeping TRI-19 open.
On INC-142: the rehearsal runbook pointed at the prod primary host name. That one is on me.
<@U12345XYZ> I will build a snapshot-restore environment so rehearsals never touch prod again (TRI-23).
PgBouncer saturation alerts go to the Platform pager from tomorrow (TRI-22).
Alex, please pair with Sarah on the ledger-db emergency runbook. Before Triton GA we cannot have only one person who knows how to operate ledger-db.
